newsitem.title: USA: N.H. governor creates new revenue panel.
newsitem.headline: N.H. governor creates new revenue panel.

text.p: New Hampshire Governor Jeanne Shaheen Wednesday authorized the creation of a new panel to advise the state on revenue estimates, saying it was needed increase public confidence in the budget process.
The voluntary panel will include represenatives of the business and academic communities as well members appointed by the Legislature and governor, Shaheen's office said in a writen statement.

"Involving people from the business and academic communities will accomplish a great deal in helping to promote public confidence in the state's revenue estimates and in the budget process in general," Shaheen said.

Shaheen said the panel was designed to "enhance and improve" the existing revenue estimating process not replace it. It will monitor economic indicators and provide periodic revenue estimates to both legislators and the governor
The executive order creating the panel was Shaheen's first since taking office. She is a Democrat and Republicans control both the New Hampshire House and Senate. (( --Boston bureau, 617-367-4106))
